Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're in the final stages of selecting a partner for a Private deployment for inference workloads that must meet our upcoming SOC 2 / SIG intake. Two asks from our side to help the reviewers and our platform team: 

1) A concise set of network/architecture diagrams that show the tenant runtime boundary, control plane vs data plane separation, and the airlock/sandbox pattern you recommend for model caching and temporary KV stores.

2) A phased onboarding checklist mapped to SIG/SOC2 controls (we want to understand what evidence you can deliver during onboarding vs what you will provide post-go-live).

Target timeline: internal compliance review week of Nov 8. Can you confirm you can deliver initial artifacts + a short kickoff call before Nov 3?

Appreciate it — happy to loop in more folks from our side if helpful.

Best,
Amelia Rhodes
Head of Platform
SentinelAI

Amelia — thanks for the clear asks.

Short answer: yes. Proposed deliverables and cadence: 

Phase 0 (by Nov 2): kickoff + context call (30m) to align on scope and any tenant-specific constraints.
Phase 1 (Nov 3–5): single-sheet high-level isolation diagrams (control plane / data plane split, tenant KV cache boundaries, egress paths) + one-page narrative.
Phase 2 (Nov 6–9): annotated onboarding checklist mapped to SIG v1.0 and SOC 2 controls with an "evidence available" / "evidence by request" column.
Phase 3 (Nov 10–12): evidence index workbook (log pulls, sample network diagrams, config snippets) and a delivery-ready ZIP for your audit team.

Kimberly will assemble the Phase 1 diagrams and the initial checklist. Logan will own the evidence index workbook and the mapping to our controls matrix.

Proposed kickoff: Nov 2, 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you?

I captured your original note below. We'll upload Phase 1 artifacts to a shared Drive and post the Jira ticket (INF-4821) with the deliverables and acceptance criteria.

Amelia / team — attached are the Phase 1 artefacts and a short technical note. Attachments are stubs in this thread; we will place the canonical files in the Drive folder and link from the Jira ticket.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- isolation-diagrams-v1.svg (diagram pack: control-plane / data-plane / tenant boundary)
- isolation-onboarding-checklist.md (phased checklist mapped to SIG/SOC2 columns)
- evidence-index-sentinel.xlsx (starter workbook with evidence rows)

Key technical notes (summary):
- Recommended minimal gating: control plane auth (mTLS + customer-managed KMS) and tenant KV cache namespaces with per-tenant keys.
- Phase A (control-plane-only onboarding): provision tenant control-plane entry, validate RBAC & audit logging, provide sample log extracts.
- Phase B (runtime segmentation): enable per-tenant runtime namespaces and KV isolation (we use namespaces + service identity tokens). Provide configuration snippets (network policy + iptables egress restrictions) in the evidence index.
- Phase C (airlock for sensitive workloads): optional airgapped artifact storage with signed transfer and dedicated egress nodes; useful if you plan to keep model artifacts on-prem.

Checklist excerpt (from the attached markdown):
- Confirm tenant network CIDR and allowed egress destinations.
- Confirm KMS integration + key rotation window.
- Provide sample audit log (30 days) and network flow sample (24h).
- Redaction policy + PII handling statement.

Links / tracking: INF-4821 (Jira) — I'll post the official artifacts there and share. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_IsolationPack

I'll be on the Nov 2 kickoff. If you want a short livestream walkthrough of the diagrams beforehand I can record a 10-minute clip.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Security Architect
Redwood Inference
